name: anti-slop
description: Fewer comments that narrate the edit and fewer stock phrases, in English and Russian: a note to Claude right after an edit that says "added X" or "as requested" in a comment, and stock openers like "You're absolutely right" dropped from stored replies.

comments.title: Comment notes
comments.description: narration: a note right after an edit whose comments narrate the change ("Added X", "as requested", "used to return", "исправил"). density: also when an edit captions its code with short one-line comments. off: nothing. At most one note per file and three per session; edits are never refused; /tmp and scratchpad files are skipped.

minComments.title: Captions before a density note
minComments.description: density only: an edit is noted when it adds at least this many one-line captions (64 characters or fewer, right above code)…

commentPercent.title: Captions per line of code (%)
commentPercent.description: density only: …and they are at least this percent of the code lines it added.

beforeNow.title: Count "раньше…" / "теперь…"
beforeNow.description: Also treat Russian history comments ("Раньше тут был…", "Теперь…") as narration. Off by default: many teams write these on purpose.

phrases.title: Phrases
phrases.description: Comma-separated. "phrase=>replacement" rewrites it in stored replies; "phrase=>" drops it where it opens a sentence; a bare phrase is only asked to be avoided.
phrases.default: Хороший вопрос=>, Отличный вопрос=>, You're absolutely right=>, You are absolutely right=>, Ты прав, Вы правы, load-bearing

rewrite.title: Rewrite stored replies
rewrite.description: Apply the replacements to the reply as the conversation keeps it, so Claude does not keep echoing the phrase. Text that looks like JSON is never rewritten.
